title: A Low-Space Algorithm for Worst-Case Subset Sum
summary: We give a uniform classical randomized decision algorithm for worst-case Subset Sum. Under every fixed polynomial bound on input-integer bit length, it uses $`\mathop{\mathrm{poly}}\nolimits (n)2^{n/2}`$ time and ordinary $`O(2^{n/5})`$ writable words of $`O(n+b)`$ bits, where b is the largest input bit length. Both resource bounds hold on every execution. The error is one-sided: the algorithm always rejects unsolvable instances and accepts each solvable instance with probability at least 2/3.

review.reason: Gives a randomized low-space algorithm for worst-case Subset Sum with stated time and space bounds.
